title: Fast Bayesian Methods for Uncertainty Quantification in Sparse AI Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24159v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating how an AI system will perform on a new benchmark need not require another large model. We use public evaluation counts to choose a weak Beta prior, then update it exactly from at most 31 revealed outcomes. The predictor uses no item semantics, pretrained weights, or inference API. Its single online evaluation in the AIMS competition returned a team-reported Brier ALC of 0.188477, a 24.6% reduction from the constant-0.5 reference. The complete submission is 7,754 bytes; a server microbenchmark measures 12.71 microseconds per prediction with 31 matching labels. We describe how source evaluations are compressed into 301 prior means and show why a concentration of two lets new evidence rapidly determine the prediction. The resulting posterior gives exact uncertainty about the modelled success rate without numerical integration or neural inference. A public evaluation covers 79 system-benchmark pairs and eight seeds, reaching Brier

translated_title: 稀疏AI评估中不确定性量化的快速贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 估计一个AI系统在新基准上的表现不一定需要另一个大型模型。我们利用公开的评估计数选择一个弱Beta先验，然后从最多31个已揭示的结果中对其进行精确更新。该预测器不使用任何题目语义、预训练权重或推理API。它在AIMS竞赛中的一次在线评估获得了团队报告的Brier ALC为0.188477，相比常数0.5的参考基线降低了24.6%。完整提交代码仅有7,754字节；服务器微基准测试显示，在匹配31个标签的情况下，每次预测仅需12.71微秒。我们描述了如何将源评估压缩为301个先验均值，并说明了为什么浓度为2能让新证据快速决定预测结果。所得的后验分布在不使用数值积分或神经推理的情况下，提供了对建模成功率的精确不确定性量化。公开评估涵盖79个系统-基准对和八个随机种子，达到了Brier……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种超轻量级贝叶斯方法，通过公开评估计数构建弱Beta先验并仅凭最多31个已揭示结果进行精确更新，无需题目语义、预训练权重或神经推理即可实现稀疏AI评估场景下的高效不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ultra-lightweight Bayesian method that constructs a weak Beta prior from public evaluation counts and updates it exactly with at most 31 revealed outcomes, enabling fast uncertainty quantification in sparse AI evaluation without item semantics, pretrained weights, or neural inference.
